thread:
liam: heads up — ran the hf->redwood conversion for user/xl-model-v2 and it produced a broken tokenizer + weight mismatch after quant. model loads but generation drops BOS and special tokens are gone.

jess: ugh. any errors in the converter logs? which rev?

liam: rev was main (no rev pin). hub download succeeded for index.json but one shard 2/4 returned 403 intermittently. convert log:
```
INFO: fetching shards [0,1,2,3]
WARN: shard fetch failed: https://huggingface.co/user/xl-model-v2/resolve/main/pytorch_model-00002-of-00004.safetensors -> 403
ERROR: weightname mismatch: expected 'transformer.h.3.attn.q_proj.weight' got 'model.layers.3.attn.q_proj.weight'
Traceback (most recent call last): KeyError: 'transformer.h.3.attn.q_proj.weight'
```

omar: 403 means we likely hit a token refresh in the hub creds. Did convertbot try to re-auth? @convertbot?

convertbot: convert started at 2356789118, attempted 3 retries on shard 2, last response 403. Auto-revpin fallback disabled. Suggested action: re-run with --revpin <commit> or bump retry backoff.

ana: missing special tokens sounds like tokenizer.json mismatch rather than weights. Did it merge tokenizer files from siblings? sometimes index.json points to tokenizer.json in a sibling repo.

liam: tokenizer.json present in shard 1, but special_tokens_map was an empty object after conversion. Also quant eval shows perplexity spike vs fp16 baseline.

jess: hypothesis: when a shard 403s we do partial write + rename which can leave a stale weightmap mapping. That could cause weight key rename mapping to apply incorrectly and tokenizer merging to skip. Can you paste the convert CLI args?

liam: `convert-hf --src hf://user/xl-model-v2 --out redwood://models/xl-v2 --quant int8 --retry 3`

omar: quick fix — re-run with `--revpin <sha>` to guarantee consistent index json + `--force-download` to avoid cached partial shards. Also open an incident for convert to auto-revpin on inconsistent shard fetches.

ana: for the weightname problem, we should add a normalization pass: if both 'model.layers.*' and 'transformer.h.*' names are present, map both patterns depending on config.json.architectures. I'll open a PR.

jess: ok please file a short repro with the exact hf URL + rev that triggered 403 and attach the convert logs. QA — can you run quant eval on a clean re-run and post a comparison (fp16 vs int8) to confirm regression? :eyes:

qa-bot: queued REPRO job 202303-78 for team/eng-ml. Will report back with perplexity/delta.

liam: filing logs and small repro now. thanks — tagging @ana for the weightname patch and @omar for the revpin retry change. We'll try a clean run tomorrow morning.

jess: thanks. small follow-up: add a non-fatal warning when special_tokens_map is empty after conversion, so we catch these earlier in CI. :thumbsup:
